adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete() action calls this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...) with no .catch handler. If the DELETE request fails, the rejection is unhandled and no error UI is shown (unlike save(), which does .catch(popupAjaxError)); the row also won’t be removed because deleteHost is only sent in the success callback.
